question: Average of 11 numbers is 45. Average of first 5 is 42 and last 5 is 46. Find the 6th number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total sum of all 11 numbers = Average × Count = 45 × 11 = 495

Sum of first 5 numbers = 42 × 5 = 210

Sum of last 5 numbers = 46 × 5 = 230

6th number = Total sum − (Sum of first 5 + Sum of last 5) = 495 − (210 + 230) = 55

**∴ Answer = 55**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When groups have different averages, the combined average is calculated as (Sum of all groups) ÷ (Total number of elements).

Deviation Method

To find a missing number in a group, subtract known sums from the total sum.

Arithmetic Mean

The average or mean of n numbers is the sum of the numbers divided by n: Mean = Sum ÷ Count.
